name: tinywebgpu
description: One file, no dependencies, no build step. A WebGPU micro-framework for shader-first work: dual-schema pipelines, fullscreen shaders and compute.

scripts.test:min: TWG_ENTRY=../tinywebgpu.min.js node test/layout.test.mjs && TWG_ENTRY=../tinywebgpu.min.js node test/frame.test.mjs
scripts.test:tiny: node build-min.mjs --tiny --with=msg,texio,read,show,pingpong,blend --out=test/.tiny-full.js && TWG_ENTRY=./.tiny-full.js node test/layout.test.mjs && node build-min.mjs --tiny --out=test/.tiny-bare.js && TWG_ENTRY=./.tiny-bare.js node test/tiny.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run build:min && npm run test:min && npm run test:tiny
scripts.build: npm run build:min && npm run build:tiny

author: Matthijs Keuper
